title: Assassin's Creed Brotherhood
summary: Optional standalone temporal anti-aliasing with camera, object, skeletal, cloth and vegetation motion. Compatible with the separate Ezio Trilogy HDR addon.
notes: Requires 32-bit ReShade with addon support. Native MSAA is optional. TAA and Object Motion default to On; debug views default to Off.
Adds no game resource upgrades, HDR, tone mapping, presentation proxy or lighting fixes. Floating-point textures are private TAA working buffers.
When using RenoDX HDR, install the Ezio Trilogy build with embedded TAA removed. Do not run two TAA implementations together.
Brotherhood only. Water, particles, ambiguous moving instances and some material paths remain unsupported.
